def backend.loggerPtrOk [GoGlobalContext] : GoInterface → Prop :=
  match x✝ with
  | GoInterface.nil => True
  | GoInterface.ok li => ∃ t l, li.ty = t.PointerType ∧ li.v = intoVal l
